projects.name: Rubrik DR backup
notes: [status email 2026-10-14] ON-TRACK. IOSP-1011 (Pure-based backup enabled, Earle) and IOSP-1014 (Pure backup confirmed, Calvin) completed. Shipment waiting on Karl and procurement. Waiting on Oracle (Prajeet), then Calvin creates the RM ticket for the maintenance window. Meeting with Network team next week to prepare Rubrik for Manchester.

[status email 2026-10-14] Timeline: IOSP-1012 enable Rubrik RAC backup 10/16 18:00 UTC (Sri); IOSP-880 validate RAC backup and replication 10/17-10/20; IOSP-1013 prepare appliances for shutdown/Manchester 10/21 (Sri, Calvin); IOSP-1010 shipment plan and contracts 10/21-TBD (Karl/Calvin, procurement); IOSP-1015 international shipment Oct 27-Nov 9; IOSP-1009 background DBA work Oct 23-Nov 23 (Earle); IOSP-1004/1005 rack and cable Nov 9-16 (Manchester team); IOSP-1006 Nov 16-Dec 6; IOSP-1007 Nov 30-Dec 6; IOSP-1008 fully production in Europe Dec 7.

[rubrik transcript 2026-10-14] Earle and Calvin: Pure backup ran several days with no issues, so IOSP-1011/1014 are passed. Plan to enable Rubrik RAC backup Friday 18:00 UTC; Igor to correct the owner on the RAC task from Earle to Sri in Jira.

[rubrik transcript 2026-10-14] Shipment: Calvin pinged Karl that morning on contract status; paperwork (via MicroAge, work done by TechX) is the holdup; shipment may be pulled earlier than Oct 27 but Calvin will not move the date until procurement signs. Appliance prep (new IP per node, shut down, about a dozen nodes) is a couple of hours; Igor set 10/21. Two Sectigo people must be present at pickup (Olu plus Jamie).
[rubrik transcript 2026-10-14] Earle: standby now running in Manchester and catching up; DBA background work could start earlier than November, possibly end of next week (Oct 23).

[rubrik transcript 2026-10-14] Calvin: validating Rubrik RAC backup (IOSP-880) must explicitly confirm replication to Manchester, since that is the prerequisite to shutting down and shipping. Sri has arranged next week's Net Ops meeting and holds the action list.

[rubrik chat 2026-10-14] Calvin posted option list for backing up Oracle RAC over CA Backup VLAN 130: (1) second VIP on backup VLAN, Prajeet to research; (2) addresses on both hosts and Rubrik finds the live host, Sri to research; (3) both hosts addressed, manual switch (current MVP fallback); (4) back up both hosts; (5) Rubrik directly in CA environment (security concerns).

[rubrik chat 2026-10-14/15] Calvin: Option 2 supported by Rubrik. RM-1658 (configure CA Backup VLAN on RAC hosts) submitted and sent for approval; RM-1660 for MCR hosts (approval requested 10-15). Prajeet 10-15: no floating backup VIP needed; give each RAC node a static backup IP and register both nodes with Rubrik; backup IPs need not be registered in Oracle Clusterware.

[rubrik chat 2026-10-15] Prajeet requested approval of RM-1661 (Oracle Credentials Wallet for Rubrik backup on SASP production RAC), planned for the weekend. Calvin: if the VLAN change is not completed in the maintenance window it pushes back Rubrik timelines.

[rubrik chat 2026-10-17] Prajeet: Oracle Credentials Wallet created and tested on both RAC nodes; Oracle part done; pending items are backup VLAN and Rubrik validation. He doubts Rubrik should need the DB user password, since that defeats the wallet.
[rubrik chat 2026-10-18] Calvin: Rubrik showing 19% (initial backup in progress).
[standup closing recap 2026-10-19] Rubrik is waiting on shipping contracts.
[standup closing recap 2026-10-16] Rubrik: approvals and playbook reviews progressing; two sprint tickets expected next week.

action_items.text: Create RM ticket for the maintenance window after Oracle response
Obtain Oracle response on RAC backup approach
Prepare Rubrik appliances for shutdown/Manchester, IP preparation (IOSP-1013)
Shipment plan and contracts (IOSP-1010), updates from procurement
Update Jira owner of RAC backup task from Earle to Sri
Update RUBRIK Project Plan / roadmap with revised dates

risks: Shipment contracts not signed by procurement (still the stated blocker on 2026-10-19), which gates IOSP-1010/1015 and the Oct 27 ship date.

CA Backup VLAN 130 addressing was missing on RAC hosts; production RAC changes only inside a maintenance window, so the initial Rubrik backup start slipped to after the weekend window (transcript suggested starting about 13:00 UTC Sunday 2026-10-18 for a 16 hour initial run, overlapping Monday morning).
Initial 16 hour Rubrik backup overlaps the primary RMAN backup (backup durations grew from 4 to 6 hours); Prajeet preferred holding RMAN, Earle ran both together.
Rubrik reaching RAC nodes across the VLAN boundary is unresolved (VIP and SCAN versus backup VLAN); Rubrik support and Oracle support tickets to be opened.
Timeline dates differ between sources for IOSP-1009 (email Oct 23-Nov 23; transcript said DBA work could start earlier).
